@everyone 🏆 5v5 TEAM EVENT – OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT

Dear Members,

We are organizing an exciting 5v5 TEAM EVENT! 🔥

A special map has been built between CLUP – GASN ON GO, and the event will take place there!

⚔️ EVENT RULES & PROHIBITIONS

🚔 POLICE TEAM

- Taser is allowed.
- Bombs are strictly prohibited.
- Play fairly and follow the event rules.

🔴 CRIMINAL TEAM

- Bombs are strictly prohibited.
- Follow the rules and respect the opposing team.

🚫 GENERAL RULES

- No bombs are allowed for either team.
- No cheating, exploiting, or unfair advantages.
- No interfering with other players.
- No disrespectful behavior or intentional disruption.
- Follow the organizers' instructions.
- Players who break the rules may be removed from the event.

📝 TEAM REGISTRATION

Want to participate? Send us the following information:

👤 Your in-game name
👥 Your teammates' in-game names
🏷️ Your team name

We will add your team to the official participant list!

🎁 WINNER'S REWARD

🏆 The winning team will receive an exclusive special role on the ZET Discord server!

A unique role will be created especially for the winning team to recognize their victory!
